name: Generic Modern Synthetic Polymer / Epoxy Crack Filler
traditional_use: Ad-hoc modern emergency crack injection, mastic sealing, and synthetic bonding.

moisture_behavior.capillary_suction: Zero capillary suction; non-wetting polymer matrix
moisture_behavior.drying_rate: Zero evaporation through the polymer plug
moisture_behavior.summary: Completely seals crack mouth while moisture continues to accumulate in the masonry core behind it.

mechanical_characteristics.stiffness: Rigid bond in epoxy; rubbery elastomeric in mastic
mechanical_characteristics.ductility: High tensile strength prevents sacrificial joint yielding
mechanical_characteristics.sacrificial_behavior: Adhesive bond strength to stone often exceeds the tensile strength of weathered historic stone
mechanical_characteristics.summary: When masonry moves, crack opens through new fractures in the historic stone rather than the synthetic plug.

thermal_characteristics.compatibility_with_historic_stones: Thermal expansion coefficient (30-60 x 10^-6 /K) is 4 to 8 times higher than historic sandstone
thermal_characteristics.summary: Severe differential expansion under direct sunlight leads to interfacial debonding or tearing of host stone arrises.

chemical_considerations.ph_nature: Neutral to slightly acidic organic polymer resin
chemical_considerations.soluble_salts_risk: Can leach organic solvents, plasticizers, and amine curing agents into porous stone pores
chemical_considerations.reactivity_with_limestone: Degrades irreversibly under UV radiation, turning yellow, brittle, and insoluble
chemical_considerations.summary: Irreversible chemical aging cross-links within the stone pore network.

reversibility.extraction_method: Virtually impossible without toxic organic solvents (dichloromethane/acetone) or mechanical grinding
reversibility.retreatability: Totally non-reversible; deeply penetrates and stains historic porous stone

heritage_compatibility.iks_alignment: Zero alignment; antithetical to vernacular craftsmanship and material breathability
heritage_compatibility.asi_intach_compliance: Strictly discouraged under international conservation standards (Venice Charter, ICOMOS)

limitations: Synthetic polymers are irreversibly locked into stone pores once cured.
Must never be used as a general mortar replacement or aesthetic crack infill on historic facade masonry.
